title: Inject project-context into control-plane chat prompt from the first manager message
specification:
# PRD: Inject project-context into control-plane chat prompt from the first manager message

Priority: high

## Problem
The control-plane chat agent currently answers from its inline prompt, repo status, and history, but it does not receive `prompts/autonomous/v2/project-context.md`. That means the first manager message lacks the same project-specific context already given to planning agents.

## Goal
Ensure the control-plane chat agent receives the repository project-context at chat startup so first-turn answers and PRD suggestions use the same stable repo context as downstream agents.

## Requirements
- Update the control-plane chat prompt builder to read `prompts/autonomous/v2/project-context.md` from the repo root and include it in the prompt sent to the chat agent.
- Make the project-context available on the very first manager message, including brand-new conversations with no prior history.
- Prefer one consistent prompt path for all turns rather than a separate first-message-only branch unless code constraints require otherwise.
- Handle missing or unreadable project-context files gracefully so chat still works and can mention reduced context if needed.
- Keep the existing `answer` plus nullable `prdProposal` response contract unchanged.

## Acceptance Criteria
- A new control-plane chat conversation includes project-context content in the prompt before the first response is generated.
- Follow-up chat turns continue to work with the existing conversation history and response schema.
- If `prompts/autonomous/v2/project-context.md` is absent or unreadable, the chat request does not crash and returns a normal response with degraded context handling.
- Existing PM planning behavior remains unchanged.

## Verification
- Add or update unit tests around `buildAgentChatPrompt` or the chat job flow to assert project-context is included.
- Add a test covering a first-turn chat request with empty history.
- Add a test covering missing project-context fallback behavior.
- Run the relevant control-plane unit tests, especially chat-related tests.
